status_note: Every template is a PROPOSAL: a conventional bra cut expressed as landmarks, drafted as ordinary pen lines the person can edit, flattened by the same engine as any hand-drawn loop, and reported with its seam error per panel. A template does not decide where a cup is cut; it shows what a conventional cut costs on this body. Templates whose landmarks are manual_only stay unavailable until a person places them (AUTHORING_UX_PLAN.md section 8, PATTERN_2D_DXF_PLAN.md section 2 and 12.4).
declared_limit: Template seams are conventional cuts, not a fit recommendation.
